title: Visual-RFT++: Extending Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to Multimodal Tool Use
title_zh: Visual-RFT++：将视觉强化微调扩展至多模态工具使用
abstract_en: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) has recently become a central paradigm for advancing Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), as demonstrated by systems such as OpenAI's o3 and the R1 series. Despite significant progress in LLMs, how to leverage RFT to unify visual perception, step-by-step reasoning, and agentic tool use into one coherent training paradigm remains an open challenge. In this work, we present Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning++ (Visual-RFT++), a unified framework that extends RFT to both visual perception tasks and multimodal agentic workflows, enabling LVLMs to reason with images, act upon images, and evaluate their own outputs using verifiable reward. With Visual-RFT++, open-source LVLMs not only show significant gains on diverse visual perception tasks, but also acquire agentic abilities such as web searching for real-time information and code-based image manipulation (e.g., cropping, rotation, and analysis). Across visual perception tasks, including fine-grained classification, few-shot detection, reasoning grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, Visual-RFT++ delivers strong gains over SFT, including a +24.3 percentage points improvement in one-shot fine-grained classification and +21.0 percentage points on COCO's 4-shot setting and +15.4 percentage points on LVIS with around several hundred samples. To evaluate agentic behaviors, we introduce the Multimodal Agentic Tool Bench (MAT) with MAT-Search and MAT-Coding. Visual-RFT++ surpasses its baseline by +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM percentage points on MAT-Coding and +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM percentage points on MAT-Search. It also shows gains of 29.3 F1 and 25.9 EM percentage points on multi-hop QA benchmarks such as 2Wiki and HotpotQA, demonstrating strong cross-modal generalization. Visual-RFT++ introduces a data-efficient and reward-driven framework that strengthens both visual reasoning and agentic adaptability.
abstract_zh: 如何在同一训练框架中统一视觉感知、逐步推理与智能体工具调用，仍是强化微调（RFT）面临的挑战。本文提出 Visual-RFT++，利用可验证奖励训练开源大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs），使其能够基于图像推理、通过代码裁剪和旋转图像，并调用网页搜索获取实时信息。相比监督微调（SFT），该方法在细粒度分类、少样本检测、推理定位和开放词汇检测上均有提升。作者还提出 Multimodal Agentic Tool Bench（MAT），分别评估网页搜索与基于代码的图像操作。Visual-RFT++ 在 MAT 的两项任务上均优于基线，并在 2Wiki 和 HotpotQA 等多跳问答基准上取得提升，显示出跨模态泛化能力。
key_points_zh: Visual-RFT++ 将视觉感知和多模态工具调用纳入同一强化微调框架，支持网页搜索及基于代码的图像裁剪、旋转与分析。
仅用数百个样本，相比 SFT，单样本细粒度分类提升 24.3 个百分点，COCO 四样本检测提升 21.0 个百分点，LVIS 提升 15.4 个百分点。
在新提出的 MAT 基准上，相比基线，MAT-Coding 的 F1 和精确匹配率（EM）分别提高 18.6 和 13.0 个百分点，MAT-Search 分别提高 10.3 和 8.7 个百分点。
在 2Wiki 和 HotpotQA 等多跳问答基准上，报告的 F1 和 EM 分别提升 29.3 和 25.9 个百分点。

agent-multimodal.reason: 将可验证奖励驱动的强化微调用于图像推理和多步工具调用，是论文的核心贡献。MAT 的编码与搜索子任务均报告了相对基线的量化增益，支持将工具调用纳入训练；摘录未提供消融或适用边界。
